job: Make someone type a name on the page before a destructive button works.
purpose: A plain form with a field, the phrase to type (fd-confirm-phrase) and a danger button. Without script the button is enabled and the server checks the posted text. With script the button stays disabled until the trimmed text equals the phrase, and a line under the field says it matches so far, differs at character n, or matches.
useWhen: A destructive action has its own page: delete a workspace, approve a restore.
The action must also work, and be checked, with no script.

avoidWhen.when: The action starts from a row or a menu and a dialog is natural.
A yes or no with nothing lost.

states.name: idle
states.how: data-state="idle" on the form; nothing typed

states.name: partial
states.how: data-state="partial"; the text so far is the start of the phrase

states.name: mismatch
states.how: data-state="mismatch"; the rule line names the first wrong character

variants.useWhen: The phrase to type, on the form; an input may carry data-match instead.

parts.role: The form; carries data-fd-confirm-inline and data-confirm.
The line that says where the typed text stands; carries data-fd-confirm-rule.

keyboard.does: Sends the form when the text matches.
